experiment_kind: constructed OR-XOR residual integration family; broader partial-acquisition diagnostic separate
target_nodes: first ceil(response_count/2)+1 nodes of a binary diagnostic tree
true_scope_construction: two neighboring ports in a hidden seeded permutation, thresholds 1..3
true_tables: OR or XOR, alternating residual bit along diagnostic tree, root bit seeded
learner_class: all canonical Boolean functions of at most two distinct port run-threshold features; tables and scopes not supplied
safe_coordinate_protocol: priced initial all-off tick; singleton port ramps 1..3 with all others off; addressed target-coordinate records only
aggregate_protocol: runtime protected bay; prepare union of learned endpoint scopes, at most four active commands; observe sum at each relevant diagnostic edge
coordinate_access: singleton-only calibration bay, or a remote runtime individual-diagnostic bay
command_access: calibration <=1 active port; runtime aggregate <=4; mission passage <=2; no command changes while moving
missions: ascending edge order then reverse and three seeded permutations, all within learned target nodes
per_mission_deadline_ticks: 60 times job_count; first mission additionally charged exact targeted commissioning tick allowance
data_cost: one bit per coordinate record, two bits per aggregate record; all recorded
limits: hand-constructed integration and explicit physical contract; not a hardware-calibrated robot or novel parity inference
